body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Speakal introduced its advanced docking station 'iPig' during CES 2009.

The iPig combines quality, performance, compatibility and style into one compact iPod docking station. Audio engineers were able to design the iPig with 5 speakers pumping out 25 watts of premium sound, in spite of its small footprint. The acoustic design elements enable the iPig to disseminate 360° sound, insuring the entire room is filled with heart-pumping sound.
